summary: Iter 32 — Multi-image upload for Commander (mh_* except mh_asker_egitim). All 9 review scenarios PASS. Backend Commander/Create/Update models accept & echo images:List[str] alongside legacy image_url (5/5 pytest cases pass, incl. CREATE→GET, PATCH update, default-empty on non-mh, and cleanup of main-agent's stale record f35ee83f...). Frontend: /komutanlar → MALİYET HESAPLAMA → mh_bina → '+ Yeni' renders [data-testid=multi-image-section] with all 4 sub-testids (multi-image-url-input, multi-image-add-url, multi-image-file-input, multi-image-upload-btn); legacy commander-image-url & commander-image-upload-btn are correctly absent. Add-via-URL: Enter key adds thumb-0, Ekle button adds thumb-1, remove-1 removes only thumb-1 leaving thumb-0. Max-10 guard: after 11 add-loop, exactly 10 thumbs remain and 'Maksimum 10 resim eklenebilir' warning is visible. Submit persisted (GET /api/commanders confirms images=[x.jpg,z.jpg] and image_url=x.jpg on the new record). Edit path: reopening the record pre-populates 2 thumbs, adding a 3rd URL then Save produces 3 images in DB (confirmed via GET). Non-mh regression: tetikci category shows legacy commander-image-url and NO multi-image-section. mh_asker_egitim regression: SoldierCalculator (sure-gun) renders — no form, no regression. Test record cleaned up (DELETE).

verified_behaviors.backend_create_with_images: POST /api/commanders {category:mh_bina, images:[3 urls]} → 200 with echoed images array & image_url
verified_behaviors.backend_patch_images: PATCH /api/commanders/{id} updates images list (note: endpoint is PATCH, not PUT)
verified_behaviors.backend_default_images: Creating commander without images key returns images=[] (List default)
verified_behaviors.legacy_ui_absent_on_mh: commander-image-url and commander-image-upload-btn NOT rendered on mh_bina
verified_behaviors.add_url_enter_key: typing URL + Enter → multi-image-thumb-0 appears with inner
verified_behaviors.add_url_button: typing URL + click multi-image-add-url → multi-image-thumb-1 appears
verified_behaviors.max_10_warning: adding 11 URLs in a loop → exactly 10 thumbs; warning text 'Maksimum 10 resim eklenebilir' visible in DOM
verified_behaviors.edit_path: reopening the record pre-populated 2 thumbs, adding 3rd URL + Save resulted in images=[x,z,edit3] persisted (verified via API GET)
verified_behaviors.non_mh_regression_tetikci: legacy commander-image-url renders, multi-image-section absent on tetikci
verified_behaviors.asker_egitim_regression: mh_asker_egitim renders SoldierCalculator ([data-testid=sure-gun] present) — form correctly NOT shown
verified_behaviors.form_submit_testid: form save button testid is 'commander-form-submit' (documented for future testers)

critical_code_review_comments: Commanders.jsx is now 1361 lines — consider splitting the form (CommanderForm) into its own component for maintainability. Approaching the 700-line guideline threshold heavily.
isMultiImage rule is duplicated implicitly (checked on both render and submit). Fine now, but if a 3rd branch is added, extract to a helper.
handleMultiFiles uploads sequentially (for-loop with await). For 10 files this could be slow; consider Promise.all with concurrency limit.
Backend Commander model uses images: List[str] = [] which is a mutable default — Pydantic handles it, but be aware if migrating to dataclass.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Bina_Multi_UI (id e9f66815-...) during UI test then DELETED. Also deleted main-agent's stale record f35ee83f-7efa-4149-95f2-f431ccd4d374. Pytest also creates & cleans TEST_MultiImg_Bina / TEST_NoImg_Tetikci records automatically via fixture teardown.
